anchors.note: Software name filter after empty ScanFilter list: keep devices whose name contains R4, R8, R9, or AE903i; dedupe by name in tempList.
BluetoothLeScanner.startScan(emptyList, SCAN_MODE_BALANCED=1). isPaired := bondState==12. Null name becomes Unknown Device.
connectToDevice → tryConnectGatt: connectGatt(ctx, autoConnect=false, callback, TRANSPORT_LE=2); retry up to 3 times at 300ms; abort if getName()==null.
STATE_CONNECTED → requestMtu(512) after 500ms; onMtuChanged → discoverServices if bond 12 or 10; onServicesDiscovered → readCharacteristicsWithDelay.
All Uniden service/characteristic UUID strings and CCCD 00002902-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb plus BTreq* ASCII commands.
Unpaired tap shows assist dialog then createBond after 3s; paired tap or BOND_BONDED broadcast calls connectBluetooth → GATT connect.
Handles BOND_STATE_CHANGED only. BOND_BONDED connects; BOND_NONE retries createBond after 2s. PAIRING_REQUEST is registered but unused.
writeCharacteristic UTF-8 to UNIDEN_SERVICE_5_UUID + WRITE_COMMAND_CHARACTERISTIC_UUID with WRITE_TYPE_NO_RESPONSE (1).
enableNotifications / enableReadSettingsNotification write CLIENT_CHARACTERISTIC_CONFIG CCCD ENABLE_NOTIFICATION_VALUE; extra read for ALERT and ETC_DATA UUIDs.
disconnect() calls BluetoothGatt.disconnect then close and nulls bluetoothGatt; also invoked from onConnectionStateChange newState==0.
Firmware download BTdn* tokens and RDresp/RDrpt* report prefixes carried on the command write/notify pair.
